content_fields.title: Test automated and secure deployment (GitHub)
content_fields.description: Verify that deployment is automated, approved and auditable.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means confirming deployments originate from the pipeline against an immutable artifact, carry an approval record, and can be traced to a specific commit.
content_fields.found: Deployment is manual and leaves no audit record beyond local shell history.
content_fields.missing: A deployment pipeline producing the records that would be verified.
content_fields.conclusion: There is no automated deployment path to verify.
content_fields.action: The CI/CD owners should verify the deployment process once it is automated.
